title: PSBGEN: a database PCB followed by one SENSEG per sensitive segment, the path from the root included
shapes: HKEP HKEPPSB: PCB TYPE=DB,DBDNAME=HKEPDB2,PROCOPT=G / SENSEG NAME=KEEP / SENSEG NAME=WALL,PARENT=KEEP / PSBGEN PSBNAME=HKEPPSB
asserts: HKEPPSB keys one ims_gen PCB fact (name HKEPDB2, the DBD it names), two SENSEG facts (KEEP, WALL, each with pcb HKEPDB2) in source order, and one PSB fact (HKEPPSB).

citations.quote: The database PCB statement defines the DBD of the database that the application program will access.
SENSEG statements must immediately follow the PCB statement to which they are related.
A separate SENSEG statement must exist for each segment type.

notes: WALL is a dependent of KEEP, so the PSB is sensitive to the root as well as to WALL, as the SENSEG page requires of a segment beneath the root. PARENT= and PROCOPT= are coded for realism; the key asserts neither (the pages read do not define them).
